alt: Server racks behind mesh doors, threaded with network cables
caption: Infrastructure
desc: Racks like these hold the logs, accounts and data an attacker wants. CyberHub labs teach you to read what they record.

alt: A blue industrial robot arm on a factory floor
caption: Operational technology
desc: Factories, power and water run on operational technology. A bug here moves something physical, so defenders learn it early.

alt: Close-up of a circuit board covered in components
caption: Hardware
desc: Security starts below the operating system. Firmware and hardware trust decide what software can rely on.

alt: Network cables plugged into a switch
caption: Networks
desc: Every attack crosses a network. Packet analysis is where CyberHub starts: see what actually crossed the wire.

caption: Legacy systems
desc: Old systems keep running long after support ends. Finding and protecting them is everyday defensive work.
